fields.fullTextSearchEscapeSpecialCharacters: Escape Special Characters in Fulltext Search

tooltips.fullTextSearchEscapeSpecialCharacters: Automatically removes special characters (+, -, *, ", (, ), @, <, >, ~) from fulltext search and switches to default search mode. This allows partial word matching and prevents special characters from being interpreted as operators.
tooltips.isWide: If checked, the detail view will be wide and side panels will be at the bottom
